dec.by_round.note: round 0 = independent roots, before any peer content

dec.final_agreement_votekey.note: final round only, official vote_key grouping (AST-canonical on code)

dec.lone_correct.note: episodes with exactly one correct member at the root round

design.identical_cell_groups.note: nominal cells that are the same physical episode set

design.never_band_pass10_max.note: ceiling of the never-solved band over 10 neutral draws

design.nominal_cells.note: module/method/checkpoint/N/B cells on the shared panel (D,E excluded)

difficulty.never_band_census.note: items with 0/10 neutral draws, checked against every 32B main episode

difficulty.policy_agreement_phi.note: mean pairwise phi of per-item correctness across the five policies

difficulty.policy_spread_by_band.note: best minus worst policy accuracy within each difficulty band

framing.confidence_contrast.note: vote-aware framing 11 minus neutral 00, independent sampling, paired on the shared 100-item panel

geom.arm_context.note: peer-exposed members carry the peer packets in context; the arms are not length-matched

geom.dec_consensus.note: agreement recomputed from item files; geometry.parquet's own outcome_agreement is 30% null and matches 54% of the time

geom.dec_root_unavailable.note: no DEC-root group has the contracted 5 comparable states: only one root member per episode was captured, so there is no within-episode before/after baseline anywhere in the data

geom.ind_full_pool.note: dimensionality of an item's whole 64-draw answer-state distribution

geom.items_per_method.note: IND_VOTE geometry exists for a minority of the 300-item panel: the native capture is ~72% complete

geom.length_confound.note: within IND only: the 5 shortest vs the 5 longest completions per item, same anchor

geom.trajectory.note: paired on items; IND subsampled to s=5 from ~58 available, DEC exact 5

hub.action_error_codes.note: typed coordinator_action errors; each consumes a hub call and a cycle

hub.by_call_bucket.note: item difficulty (p1) is shown beside accuracy because long episodes sit on much harder items

hub.delegation_rate.note: episodes with at least one delegation cycle (counters.delegation_cycles > 0)

hub.finish_reason_transitions.note: consecutive hub calls; length->length is the re-prompt loop

hub.single_call_vs_single_draw.note: hub episodes that never delegated vs the neutral 10-draw bank pass@1 on the same items

hub.tokens_by_call_index.note: index 5 pools calls 6+; 'uncapped' excludes calls that hit the 8192 output cap, which is the honest version of 'reasons longer each retry'

hub.within_never_band.note: difficulty held constant: the call-count gradient largely disappears

policy.flagship.source: module A, 32B, N=5, B=4, main split

probe.candidate_correctness.note: 'within_item' asks whether the state distinguishes right from wrong SIBLINGS of the same question

probe.confidence_representation.note: the value is fully decodable only at the answer token, i.e. after it has been emitted

probe.hub_delegation.note: the pooled figure is largely a domain classifier; inside the never-solved HLE band the signal is gone

probe.majority_membership.note: compare with probe.candidate_correctness: mainstream-ness is more legible than correctness

probe.report_architecture.note: which orchestration produced this report, 3-way, chance 1/3

probe.report_correctness.note: whether the delivered answer is right; compare task_only against report_state

probe.report_displacement.note: how far the compiled evidence moves the reader's state, relative to the task-only state

probe.trajectory.note: block 31, independent solvers; the last column is between-item difficulty

scale.panel_note.note: the 32B row of the dense panel is module A restricted to the M-panel items and the three dense-panel methods (amendment M1: the 32B row aliases main A)

selection.archive_quality.source: module A archive pools, main split

ttc.gap_at_k.note: pass@k minus VOTE@k, pooled across domains

ttc.selector_at_k.note: VOTE@k and JUDGE_BEST@k over the same bank prefixes
